# EarthSciDiscretizations — Rule Catalog

<!-- AUTOGENERATED by `docs/generate_rule_catalog.jl`. Do not edit by hand — regenerate from `discretizations/` instead. -->

Authoritative manifest of every discretization rule and grid-family schema currently committed under `discretizations`. Each row corresponds to one inner rule key inside one JSON file, as discovered via `EarthSciDiscretizations.load_rules` — the same production path the walker harness uses for rule discovery.

Hand-authored planning prose (aspirational rules not yet committed, audit lenses, and source-by-source roadmaps) is preserved in [`rule-catalog-roadmap.md`](rule-catalog-roadmap.md) until a follow-up bead migrates that content into a generated form.

## How to read this catalog

Columns:

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `name` | Inner rule key (`discretizations.<name>` or `rules.<name>`). Usually matches the filename stem. |
| `shape` | `discretizations` (stencil/replacement rule), `rules` (index-rewrite / boundary-condition rule), `schema` (grid-family schema), `unknown`/`parse_error` (diagnostic). |
| `op` | `applies_to.op` for stencil rules, or `pattern.op` for index-rewrite rules. The mathematical operator each rule discretizes. |
| `grid_family` | The rule's declared `grid_family` field, or the region for index-rewrite rules. |
| `accuracy` | Truncation order or accuracy claim from the rule, verbatim. |
| `reference` | One-line citation derived from `reference` / `schema_notes` / `composition_hint` (truncated). |
| `path` | Repo-relative path to the JSON file. |
